newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE BUDAPEST FX FUTURES TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE BUDAPEST FX FUTURES TRADE.

text.p: Dollar and mark basket deals, especially for December, accounted for most turnover on both of Budapest's currency futures markets on Friday.

The mark and dollar, which make up 70 percent and 30 percent respectively of the central bank basket against which the forint floats, took up two-thirds of the low 1.9 billion forints turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange.
The dollar firmed while the mark firmed for all maturities, reflecting developments on the international spot market.
The Budapest Stock Exchange saw turnover 1.4 billion forints, mostly taken up by a basket deal for June.
